instruction: Can you help me rename the "backup_2024_Q1" folder on the desktop to "backup_2024_Q2"?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires renaming directory from 'backup_2024_Q1' to 'backup_2024_Q2'. Evaluator checks if the renamed directory exists using shell command. This variation uses a quarterly backup pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies BOTH aspects of the rename operation using compound shell command logic

The command '[ -d ~/Desktop/backup_2024_Q2 ] && [ ! -d ~/Desktop/backup_2024_Q1 ] && echo "Renamed successfully" || echo "Rename failed"' checks: (1) new directory exists AND (2) old directory does NOT exist
Both conditions must be true (connected by &&) for success output, preventing false positives where user only creates new directory without removing old
The exact_match metric correctly compares command output against expected 'Renamed successfully\n' value
Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies 100% of rename semantics (new exists AND old removed)
